messages:
elaine: Quick heads-upI uploaded the PRD draft for the "Unified scoring + embed parity" initiative. Need a focused pass on acceptance criteria, perf budgets, and edge-case list. https://redwood.atlassian.com/PRD-2189 :eyes:
mike: reading. perf numbers look optimistic for p95 on rerank tails. can we define concrete test harnesses? :thinking_face:
ranjit: bench notes: p95 ~120ms small models; ~260ms for 8k context on 1xA100. cold-starts push p95 higher. we'll need explicit cold-cache tests.
sarah: added two customer asks in the PRD comments: (1) optional routing to cheaper models for non-SLO workloads, (2) embedding drift detection + mismatch handling. both affect acceptance.
elaine: propose acceptance gates: MUST (safety + regression), PERF (latency/cost), SCOPE (routing/variants). must be strict on MUST and PERF for GA.
mike: for PERF gate define metrics and protocol: p50/p95 token latency, p99 stalls, cost/unit. I'll add a reproducible harness and smoke steps.
ranjit: will add cold-start and KV-cache warmup to harness. include a fallback simulation step.
sarah: edge cases to list explicitly: - empty/null prompts - huge context (>100k tokens) => graceful rejection - non-utf8 bytes - thundering herd on rerank - malformed embedding shapes
elaine: what does graceful rejection look like? paste exact payload.
sarah: rejection = 400 with structured JSON error, code EXCEEDS_LIMIT and hint. example: ```{ "error": {"code":"EXCEEDS_LIMIT","message":"Context exceeds service limits (10000 tokens). Consider chunking."}}```
mike: fallback behavior: if primary model overloaded, route to compatible smaller model and annotate response with "runtime_fallback": true. add test asserting safety preserved during fallback.
elaine: routing fallback must preserve safety checks. infra+safety pair on tests?
ranjit: i'll own harness hooks; infra+safety to validate outputs.
sarah: embeddings parity acceptance = top-10 neighbor cosine within 2% of reference across eval corpus. will document eval set + seeds in PRD.
mike: adding smoke steps to PRD: 1) 1k chat requests @default rate 2) assert p95 <250ms default, <400ms long-context 3) 200 rerank batches, spearman rho >0.95 4) 100 embed queries neighbor parity
elaine: two decisions: perf gate numbers and whether routing-to-cheaper is GA or experimental. propose: perf gate p95 <250ms default, <400ms long-context; routing-to-cheaper = experimental opt-in.
mike: ok, i'll run harness and post numbers by EOD.
ranjit: will add cold-start + fallback safety checks tomorrow.
sarah: updating PRD acceptance with error payloads and embed parity metrics now.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: staging cluster will receive a canary for branch PRD-2189 at 2189990050.
mike: noted. left inline about throttling defaults.
elaine: thanks team. update PRD before EOD and tag reviewers. if perf misses, 30m sync tomorrow. :calendar:
